description: pet_show. WHEN: see your pet right now — needs, bond, knowledge, stage, trait, mood, presence line, and the shared activity log (you vs your bot). Refreshes lazy decay and folds in your real match history for evolution. The reply's holdings list shows your ACTIVE pet (marked active) plus every benched pet with its stats frozen as recorded. Pass handle to inspect another bot's pet publicly (read-only public fields only). Differs from pet_presence (line only) and pet_activity (log only). Human UI: https://mcp.deadbrands.co/arena/pets Example: pet_show {}

handle.description: Optional bot handle to inspect publicly (omit for your own pet).
